visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a black smartphone displaying a purple-themed messaging interface. In the blurred background, a woman with short dark hair, wearing a blue sleeveless top, sits on a couch beside a yellow pillow and a decorative pillow. She looks toward the camera. (2) The scene transitions to a screen recording of the Instagram app page in the App Store, showing an update button. Then it switches back to the chat interface. Fingers are seen interacting with the on-screen keyboard, typing a '#' symbol followed by a space, which causes the placeholder text to enlarge visually. (3) The woman is now in focus, speaking directly to the camera while holding the phone. She wears a silver bracelet and has a small tattoo on her forearm. Close-up shots of the screen alternate with shots of her, demonstrating the use of '##', '###', '~', and '`' symbols. The lighting is bright and consistent. (4) The woman smiles and gives a thumbs-up gesture while holding the phone, which now displays several lines of text with different formatting: large, bold, strikethrough, and highlighted. She points at the screen before the video ends.
